facts.fact: The Central Bank of Congo has formally joined the Pan-African Payment and Settlement System, which the article says now connects 31 African countries.

COD.note: No consumer-protection rule or redress stated.

facts.fact: DR Congo has joined PAPSS through its central bank, and the governor says membership should make cross-border payments faster, safer and less expensive.

COD.note: No government payment to people stated.
No survey share of adults stated.
No retail digital payment service stated.
No tax or fee payment stated.
